speaker: mz
event: Acquired Podcast Live at Chase Center
quote: Yeah, we wouldn't have been able to get built without open source. I think probably that's true for any new company that's been created since the late 1990s or something. For us, open source has been important and valuable.
quote_zh: 沒有開源，我們根本建不起來。我想大概自一九九〇年代晚期以來成立的新公司都是如此。對我們來說，開源一直很重要、很有價值。
why_notable_zh: 把 Meta 自身成長史與開源基礎設施綁定的公開表述（後接 Open Compute／Llama 脈絡）。

speaker: mz
event: Acquired Podcast Live at Chase Center
quote: A few years ago, I would have predicted that AR holograms would have been available before full scale AI. And now I think it's probably going to be the other order.
quote_zh: 幾年前我會預測擴增實境全像會比完整規模的人工智慧更早到位；現在我認為順序大概會反过来。
why_notable_zh: 標誌 Meta 把 Ray-Ban Meta／Meta AI 主功能轉向的技術時序修正。
draft_note: HappyScribe；與 week2 草案英原句不重複。抓取 2026-09-15 Asia/Taipei。

speaker: mz
event: Acquired Podcast Live at Chase Center
quote: For my next stage, for the next stage of the company, the next 15 years, I want us to build more things that are awesome in addition to things that are good.
quote_zh: 對我下一階段、對公司下一階段——未來十五年——我希望我們在做「好」的東西之外，再多做一些「awesome」的東西。
why_notable_zh: 「good vs awesome」價值觀轉折，對應 Reality Labs／人工智慧長線投資敘事。

speaker: mz
event: Acquired Podcast Live at Chase Center
quote: Part of my goal for the next 10, 15 years, the next generation of platforms, is to build the next generation of open platforms and have the open platforms win.
quote_zh: 我未來十年、十五年——下一代平台——的目標之一，就是打造下一代開放平台，並讓開放平台勝出。
why_notable_zh: 把開源／開放平台上升到下一世代運算平台競爭的策略目標句。

speaker: mz
event: Acquired Podcast Live at Chase Center
quote: Just do something that you care about. If you're trying to run our strategy, try to learn as quickly as you can. ... Look, learn from other people's successes and failures, but do your own thing.
quote_zh: 去做你在乎的事。若你要跑我們這套策略，就盡可能學得快。……向別人的成敗學習，但走自己的路。
why_notable_zh: 給現場創辦人的收束建議，與「學得比別人快」策略呼應。

speaker: mz
quote: Once you get a display in there, whether it's the kind of wide holographic field of view like we showed with Orion or just a smaller display that might be good for displaying some information. And that's also going to unlock a lot of value where you can just interact with an AI assistant throughout the day in this multimodal way.
quote_zh: 一旦眼鏡裡有了顯示器——不論是像我們用 Orion 展示的那種寬廣全像視野，或只是適合顯示部分資訊的較小顯示器——也會釋放大量價值，讓你可以整天以多模態方式與人工智慧助理互動。
why_notable_zh: 眼鏡敘事從「感測／對話」延伸到「顯示／多模態介面」的關鍵補句（CNBC 報導亦節錄前半）。
draft_note: 同一場為 2025-07-30 Meta 第二季財報電話會議；官方 PDF 逐字稿。CNBC 同場報導亦有相近節錄：https://www.cnbc.com/2025/07/30/metas-big-ai-spending-blitz-will-continue-into-2026-.html 。與 week1 Q01–Q03 英原句不重複。抓取 2026-09-15 Asia/Taipei。

speaker: mz
quote: I wear contact lenses, I feel like if I didn't have my vision corrected, I'd be sort of at a cognitive disadvantage going through the world. And I think in the future, if you don't have glasses that have AI or some way to interact with AI, I think you're kind of similarly probably be at a pretty significant cognitive disadvantage compared to other people who you're working with, or competing against.
quote_zh: 我戴隱形眼鏡；若沒有矯正視力，走在世上會有點認知劣勢。我認為未來若你沒有具備人工智慧的眼鏡、或其他與人工智慧互動的方式，相對於共事或競爭的人，大概也會處於相當明顯的認知劣勢。
why_notable_zh: 「cognitive disadvantage」標題級金句，把 AI 眼鏡提升到日常能力基礎設施。
draft_note: 官方 PDF；交叉：https://www.uploadvr.com/zuckerberg-people-without-smart-glasses-will-be-at-cognitive-disadvantage/ 。抓取 2026-09-15 Asia/Taipei。

speaker: mz
quote: I think that AI glasses are going to be the main way that we integrate superintelligence into our day-to-day lives, so it's important to have all these different styles that appeal to different people in different settings.
quote_zh: 我認為人工智慧眼鏡會是我們把超智慧整合進日常生活的主要方式，因此需要各種風格以吸引不同情境的人。
why_notable_zh: 把 Ray-Ban／Oakley 產品線直接接到「個人超智慧」願景的準備稿金句。
draft_note: 官方 PDF 開場準備稿。抓取 2026-09-15 Asia/Taipei。

speaker: mz
quote: Over the last few months we have begun to see glimpses of our AI systems improving themselves. The improvement is slow for now, but undeniable. Developing superintelligence -- which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence in every way -- we think is now in sight.
quote_zh: 過去幾個月我們開始看到人工智慧系統自我改進的端倪；進展目前緩慢，但無可否認。開發超智慧——我們定義為在各方面超越人類智能的人工智慧——我們認為已在可見範圍內。
why_notable_zh: 公開定義 personal／superintelligence 時間感與自我改進觀察。
draft_note: 官方 PDF 準備稿；與 week1 三則 CNBC 節錄不重複。抓取 2026-09-15 Asia/Taipei。

speaker: mz
quote: I've just gotten a little bit more convinced around the ability for small talent-dense teams to be the optimal configuration for driving frontier research. ... For the leading research on superintelligence, you really want the smallest group that can hold the whole thing in their head.
quote_zh: 我更相信：小型、人才密度高的團隊，才是推動前沿研究的最佳配置。……對超智慧的領先研究，你真正要的是能把整件事裝進腦子裡的最小群體。
why_notable_zh: 解釋為何組 Meta Superintelligence Labs 採小而密團隊，而非廣告／推薦系統那種千人規模。
draft_note: 官方 PDF Q&A；省略號略去中間對照 Instagram／廣告系統的說明。抓取 2026-09-15 Asia/Taipei。

speaker: sa

quote_zh: 寫碼模型已經徹底改變公司做事方式，以及他們打造產品的效率與速度。……我認為可以公平地說，寫碼就是當下的魔法。

speaker: sa
quote: We still don't think the world has appreciated how much A.I., every person and every business is going to want. Right now, you still send a request to an A.I., and it does something for you and gives you an answer back. But, very soon, an A.I. will just be running for you in the background all the time...
quote_zh: 我們仍認為世界還沒意識到每個人、每家企業會需要多少人工智慧。現在你還是送出請求、得到回答；但很快，人工智慧會一直在背景替你跑……
why_notable_zh: 從「請求—回應」轉向「常駐背景代理」的用量曲線論證。

speaker: sa
quote: The companies that I know that have adopted A.I. the most are also the ones hiring the most. And the companies, as a general rule, that are talking about doing layoffs because of A.I. are the ones adopting A.I. the least.
quote_zh: 我認識的、採用人工智慧最多的公司，往往也是聘人最多的；而一般來說，拿人工智慧當裁員理由的，反而是採用最少的。
why_notable_zh: 對「人工智慧取代就業」敘事的現場反例，屬本場就業／產能討論核心。

speaker: sa
quote: I think our industry underestimated how much we're going to be able to keep people at the center of everything in an economy that is and a world that is based on people.
quote_zh: 我認為我們這個產業低估了：在以人為本的經濟與世界裡，我們仍能把人留在一切的中心。
why_notable_zh: 修正先前較悲觀就業預判後的「人在迴路」結論句。

quote_zh: 我希望人類有朝一日擴展到星辰，資料中心也一起去；但我們現在會專注在地球上建設。……這對我們不是短期優先。

speaker: jh
quote: We are fungible, meaning that you can use Nvidia across the entire life cycle of AI, from data processing, pre-training, post-training, all the way to deploying the AI agents. ... We literally run every single model. We're the only company that I know that runs every single frontier model, every closed model, every open model.
quote_zh: 我們是可互換的：你可以在人工智慧全生命週期用輝達——從資料處理、預訓練、後訓練一路到部署代理人。……我們幾乎跑每一個模型；就我所知，我們是唯一能跑每一個前沿、封閉與開源模型的公司。

speaker: jh
quote: Because of CUDA, our software is getting better all the time. We ship the hardware in the beginning. We sell you the hardware, but we continuously improve the algorithms underneath so that the machinery gets better and better and better over time. ... Just like fine wine.
quote_zh: 因為 CUDA，我們的軟體一直在變好。我們一開始出貨硬體、賣給你硬體，但會持續改進底層演算法，讓機器越用越好……就像陳年好酒。
why_notable_zh: 回應「三四年就要報廢」誤區；軟體定義基礎設施的代表性比喻。

speaker: jh
quote: This is the first generation of startups that needed tens of billions of dollars to get funded. ... That's just never happened. But that's really the nature of AI, the cost of building AI, the cost of deploying AI, just, it's very capital intensive. ... Frankly, I just wish I invested more.
quote_zh: 這是第一代需要數百億美元才能起步融資的新創。……這種事以前從沒發生過，但這就是人工智慧的本質：建造與部署都很資本密集。……坦白說，我只恨自己投資得不夠多。
why_notable_zh: 回擊「輝達變銀行／危險」論述：說明為何要投資前沿實驗室。

quote_zh: 輝達是唯一全堆疊人工智慧工廠級運算平台；也是唯一同時存在於每一朵雲、本地、邊緣、主權雲與新雲的平台——到處都在。
